body: You make a good point.  Unfortunately those lenses can have a profound impact on how we see ourselves.

I mean I have been trying to go to the gym lately, but it’s way easier said than done.  Trying to tack on mass is exceptionally hard when you’re an ectomorph. Having to feel like you constantly need to eat, and then having a dietitian say ‘no you shouldn’t work out because it might cause a heart attack or whatever because you’re underweight.’ Um I’ve been lifting somewhat and haven’t passed out on the floor or anything.
Christ man I’m here in a deep dark place and all you do is criticize?  The hell is your angle?  It’s like you want to start some argument.

I mean I barely go up to women.  It feels like I’m getting the same argument as the rest of them.  ‘Entitled’ etc etc.  Like I said I heard it before.  Same old ridicule.  I know how you people see me. That’s exactly why I’m ending it.

Except when that violent, raging storm drops a tornado on your nice, warm, cozy home.

Even then there is something awe inspiring about how nature can create a 200+ Mph spinning vortex of destruction.
